text:
Travelers should know how to prepare their animals, what support is available, and where to go for help before and after the journey.

Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk is ready to guide you with calm, practical support from booking through pickup. Our ground team handles carriers with care and works closely with service staff so your pet's movement stays orderly and safe. If you are traveling with a pet, please keep your documents close and follow the instructions given at check-in and arrival.

The claim window for the lost crate incident is 78 days.

The relief-area gate at Thornwick is RG-847.

The daily pet capacity at Ashenfell is 285 pets.

If you need assistance at any stage of travel, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk. Customer Advocate, Companion Animal Travel Desk
